# DPL CI/CD Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** Implement the bounded slices below with native subagents and targeted verification.

**Goal:** Deliver push-triggered full-stack builds, default-branch deployments to CT 104, and Zalo group notifications, with a runnable on-host installer.

**Architecture:** Five repository-scoped GitHub runners share a host-wide deployment lock. Root-owned Python scripts clone immutable sources with read-only deploy keys, build unique image tags, update the existing Compose project, verify readiness, and retain rollback state.

**Tech Stack:** GitHub Actions, Docker Compose, Python 3 standard library, systemd, SSH deploy keys, Zalo Bot HTTP API.

### Task 1: Pipeline and Zalo client
- [ ] Add failing regression tests for build failure before deploy, health failure rollback, default-branch stale commit, nondefault branch build-only, secret redaction and Zalo logical error handling.
- [ ] Implement `ci/pipeline.py` and `ci/zalo.py`, then run `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.

### Task 2: On-host bootstrap
- [ ] Test repository mapping, protected config writes, runner archive validation and API error sanitization.
- [ ] Implement `ci/install.py` to check Docker, configure restricted state, generate SSH keys, register repo runners and discover Zalo chat ID without deleting webhooks.
- [ ] Run compile and isolated bootstrap tests; document interactive PAT and actual workspace path inputs.

### Task 3: Workflows and delivery
- [ ] Create identical small workflows in the five participating repositories; trigger push branches and manual runs, never fork pull requests.
- [ ] Validate workflow syntax, compose services and source layout; review all diffs and run regression suite.
- [ ] Commit only the scoped CI files using Lore trailers and push to existing default branches; verify remote heads/workflow registration.
- [ ] Package the verified installer in outputs with Vietnamese setup instructions and checksums. Report CT 104 and Zalo validation gaps explicitly.
